title: Research: catalog real-world multi-part subject line formats
description:
Before writing any code, catalog the actual subject line conventions used in the wild for multi-part UUencoded Usenet/email posts. This is design research, not implementation.

Known formats to document:
- (03/17) suffix: 'filename.tar.gz (03/17)'
- [03/17] variant
- Part 3/17, Part 03 of 17, part3of17
- '[BINARY] filename - Part 3 of 12'
- Subject lines with no part marker on part 1 (TOC or first part has no number)
- Part 0 as TOC vs part 1 as TOC
- yEnc subject lines (document but mark as out of scope)

Deliverable: a comment on this issue listing observed formats with real examples, and a proposed regex/parser design that covers at least 90% of observed cases. Get approval before filing implementation issues.
close_reason: Research complete, findings documented as issue comment
